title: He said he is coming over to my house.
scene: 朋友说来家里玩，时间没定死。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: What did Leo say to you today?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: He said he is coming over to my house.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Did he ask his mom about it first?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Yes, he said that she said yes.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: When is he going to come over?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: He said maybe on Saturday he can come.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Tell him he should bring a toy to share.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: He said he will bring his big truck.

variations: "Leo" 换 "Mia"；"coming to my house" 换 "bringing a toy"。
